# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are made against the latest released version of
`project-sandbox`. Upgrade to the latest version before reporting a problem or
requesting a fix.

## Reporting a security issue

Report security problems through
[GitHub Issues](https://github.com/pkrusche/project-sandbox/issues/new). Include
the affected version, runtime, operating system, reproduction steps, expected
behavior, and observed behavior.

Issues are public. Do not include API keys, access tokens, passwords, private
repository contents, personal information, or other live secrets. Revoke and
rotate any credential that may have been exposed before filing the issue, and
use redacted logs or a minimal reproduction where possible.

For details about the project's trust boundaries, credential forwarding, and
network restrictions, see the [security model](../docs/security.md).
